workflow.versioning_note: B01 pins immutable registry content by workflow_id; schema_version is a document format version. AT-29 requires old v1 executions to resume with v1 semantics after v2 deployment, or an explicit migration.

relevant_rules: A failed node remains FAILED; retry creates a new attempt. New business cycle does not rewrite old records.
WAITING_HUMAN may succeed only with assigned human submission; permission prompt and human business task share notification UX but have different task kinds.
Pause takes effect at safe boundary; record resume_state and resume_step to restore wait or invoke a new attempt. Completed in-flight work may succeed while job remains paused.
Canceled workflow cannot erase already-published remote state; reconcile and retain receipt.

agent_contract.rule: completed is an agent execution outcome, never a quality gate PASS
agent_contract.concurrency: One writer per workspace; TC uses isolated test worktree and patch handoff; code-dev integration serializes.

data_model.consistency: Temporal is authoritative for process transitions. PostgreSQL stores command inbox/outbox, immutable evidence and query projections. Workflow transitions project through idempotent activities. API 202 is not final success.
data_model.atomicity_rule: Submit command and outbox record atomically
data_model.authorization_rule: Every query/download checks project membership and job ownership/delegated role. Internal workers/bridge tokens additionally scoped to assignments.

openapi.create_job: POST /api/v1/jobs returns 202 CommandReceipt; accepted durable command is not completed operation.
openapi.command_status: GET /api/v1/commands/{command_id} reports accepted/applied/rejected, applied_revision and error.
openapi.events: GET /api/v1/jobs/{job_id}/events is defined but not implemented; B04 owns event/SSE delivery.

facts: create captures an immutable B01 SnapshotRecord, then atomically inserts the DRAFT job, accepted command, pending outbox row and RESERVED workspace intent
Idempotency is actor/route/key scoped; same body returns the original accepted receipt, conflicting body is rejected
202 response status is accepted; this module does not apply the command or advance job state
The current job row resolves workflow_id from SnapshotRecord.workflow_id (ifpmic-sw-v1); the public workflow_version field is a projection of that ID
command status read is scoped to current session/project/job authorization
commands default to accepted; outbox defaults pending; jobs default DRAFT/revision 0/cycle 0; workspace intent defaults RESERVED/generation 0
Runtime can insert the initial job/command/outbox/intent group but cannot update job status, command status/applied_revision, or outbox state
The workspace worker has its own narrow intent transition permissions; the migration explicitly states runtime cannot apply commands/outbox and B03 needs a separate migration
No Temporal schema, workflow process table or event projection is defined in this migration
This G5 worker provisions private workspace paths and transitions workspace_intents RESERVED/PROVISIONING/READY/ERROR
READY means workspace preparation only; module docstring states it does not apply a job command
It does not start workflow steps, invoke agent-contract functions, transition job state, or mark commands applied
Implemented job ingress and read projections cover create/list/detail/command status; plan decision, human submission, controls, release, approval, and events are absent
No workflow dispatcher or Temporal client/worker route is registered
B01 snapshot resolver binds immutable content to workflow_id=ifpmic-sw-v1 and schema_version=1.0.0
It validates/returns the static workflow definition; it does not execute it

current_implementation_observations.implementation_search: Read-only search found no Temporal client/SDK, workflow execution worker, command outbox dispatcher, or job transition applier in services/ifpmic_api. Existing WorkspaceService is a separate filesystem provisioner, not an execution substitute.
current_implementation_observations.current_persistence_boundary: The outbox row is pending and the command remains accepted after G4/G5. No accepted evidence proves delivery, workflow start, command application, step execution, human task creation, workflow recovery, or version-compatible resume.

normal: accepted command reaches exactly one durable workflow start through outbox
workflow/registry identity remains pinned as ifpmic-sw-v1
agent completed/needs_human/failed/canceled/interrupted remain distinct from step/gate outcomes
human-owned P07/P21 cannot advance without assigned human submission
one effective command and workflow per idempotency identity; 202 remains acceptance, then applied/rejected is explicit
exception: crash after API commit but before outbox delivery; restart redispatches same command_id without loss or duplicate workflow
crash after Temporal start but before outbox acknowledgement; replay detects existing workflow and does not start a second one
Temporal unavailable/start timeout and uncertain start outcome remain reconciling until queried
human wait persists across process restart and resume uses exact pinned workflow version
result/outbox/event delivery duplicates are idempotent; stale cycle/attempt/execution results cannot advance current state
boundary: commit/dispatch/ack ordering and lease/visibility timeout boundaries
P07/P21 completion without human proof, wrong actor/task/version and duplicate submission
v1 human-wait execution resumed after v2 deployment; no silent workflow reinterpretation
same idempotency key with same/different body, same command ID replay, unique workflow ID collision
worker/outbox restart at each durable boundary; no job state advances from workspace READY alone
regression: B01 exact workflow_id/content fingerprint and old source pins
G4 accepted command/DB atomic four-row group and immutable 202 receipt
G5 workspace READY/lease/recovery unchanged and not treated as command application
API command GET before/after apply/reject and unauthorized job/command access remain scoped
no fabricated SSE/notification success until B04 endpoints are implemented

open_questions_for_plan_not_resolved_by_: Temporal workflow ID derivation, uniqueness scope, task queue, worker versioning/Build ID policy and how pinned workflow_id maps to Temporal type/version are not specified.
Exact outbox poll/claim/lease/ack schema, transaction boundaries, retry/backoff, poison-message handling and uncertain Temporal start reconciliation are not specified.

The original state contract gives step transitions and human evidence rules but not an executable command-to-transition payload/API mapping for command kinds, expected_revision, job revision or error DTOs.

Human task persistence/assignment/authorization/submission API and notification creation are data-model concepts; corresponding OpenAPI write endpoints are absent in current app and assigned partly to B04.

AT-16 says redeliver by command_id and avoid duplicate; exact proof oracle for a crash between remote Temporal start and local acknowledgement needs a deterministic Temporal test seam or actual test server.
AT-29 does not choose Temporal worker versioning, compatibility duration, workflow replay migration procedure or retirement criteria for old v1 workers.

The use of Paperclip as upper orchestration versus Temporal as sole process-transition authority must remain explicit; no Paperclip routine/automatic transition may independently dispatch the same task.

scope_and_acceptance_boundary.statement: This record is not a B03 plan, implementation, Temporal operation, or acceptance result. G4/G5 verification reports retain their historical pre-review labels; their pinned final reviews accept only the respective local slices. They bound existing behavior and do not prove B03 execution.
